cases.reason: Same words (non-zero / nonzero). What "evaluates to" means is the arithmetic in effect: in 2002 ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD applies 8.8.1.3 to every arithmetic expression (11.8.4.2 GR2), a mode 2023 does not have, so the 2023 row has no evidence for it. B * 1000 + 1 - B * 1000 with B = 10**30 is 0 under 2002 standard arithmetic (10**33 + 1 truncates to 32 digits), so START must fail with 23; the pinned compiler evaluates 1 and succeeds. Known defect kb/Work PB5575 reaches this rule: the pinned tree (coderead85-tree-d, 24372b7b17) has only the compile-time arm; the run-time arm (32-digit truncation, 31-digit rounding at the final transfer) landed on main 2026-11-15 after the pin (bb0c8648e1 and its landing), so the probe must be re-run on a post-landing build before the row is closed. Not a new defect.
cases.needs: its own verdict: at --std 2002 under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD the LENGTH expression is evaluated by 2002 standard arithmetic; re-probe start-len-std.cob on a build with the PB5575 run-time arm (expected INVALID 23) and adopt it as the 2002 witness

cases.reason: START general format identical in both editions (FIRST / KEY ... WITH LENGTH / LAST, INVALID KEY group). 2002 SR6 equals 2023 SR6; 2002 SR4 (qualification) vs 2023 SR4 (no OCCURS) is outside this rule. 2002 RECORD KEY keys are alphanumeric or national only (12.3.4.12 SR2), as in 2023. Only widening is SUPPRESS WHEN (2023).

2002 GR17 a)-e) equal 2023 GR17 without the SUPPRESS WHEN sentence (2023 addition). The comparison is alphanumeric or national of equal length in both; 2002 record keys cannot be of another class (12.3.4.12 SR2), so no 2002-only operand class reaches e). Witnesses named by the reader pass at 2002.

Same sentence; the I-O status values START can produce (00, 23, 46, 47, 9x) are unchanged. The 2023 status changes in E.2 (items 15-18: 04, 07, 0x, 37) and EC-I-O-WARNING concern OPEN/CLOSE/READ or are enabled only by an explicit 2023 TURN, so none reaches a 2002 START.

The rule has no content of its own: transfer of control is 'as specified in 9.1.13'. That referenced clause is not the same text as 2023 9.1.14. 2002 9.1.13 3)/4) run only 'a USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure ... associated with the file connector' and otherwise send control to the end of the statement; 2023 9.1.14 3) runs 'any applicable exception processing statements'. 2023 Annex E.2 item 19 a) records exactly this as a substantive change: with no INVALID KEY phrase, an INPUT/OUTPUT/I-O/EXTEND declarative 'would not have been executed. It will now be executed'. Under the literal 2002 reading, a START with no INVALID KEY phrase on a file open INPUT whose only declarative is USE ... ON INPUT (or a file-less USE AFTER EC EC-I-O-INVALID-KEY) runs no declarative; 2002 9.1.12 and USE GR3/GR6 b) point the other way, so 2002 is at best ambiguous here. The project's determination (kb/Work PB344) runs the declarative at every edition, but it is derived from 2023 Annex E and 1985 NIST READ tests, not from the 2002 text, and its 2002 witness (pb344_use_mode_invalid_key_2002) exercises WRITE and READ, not START. The reader's START evidence (pb352, pb870) covers only file-name declaratives. Probes at --std 2002: both declaratives run (DECL-INPUT FS=23; DECL-EC-IK FS=23), the same as at 2023.

cases.reason: Same words except the numeric-comparison cross-reference. Under 2002 ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD the comparison is of an unsigned integer relative key with a relative record number, both at most 31 digits, so the 32-digit standard-arithmetic difference cannot change the outcome.

2002 STRING general format matches 2023 (only the ellipsis placement in the transcription differs). 2002 SR1 admits the same alphanumeric/boolean/national literals and display/national identifiers as 2023 SR1; 2023 adds only SR3 (zero-length literal-2) and SR11 (variable-length group). The refusal witness is refused at 2002.

Same words; the rule fixes the result as undefined itself ('even if they are defined by the same data description entry'), so the difference between 2002 14.5.9 and 2023 14.6.10 cannot reach it. No 2002-only operand class exists in STRING.

2002 spells out explicit transfer from imperative-statement-2; 2023 says 'If control is returned from imperative-statement-2'. A GO TO out of imperative-statement-2 leaves the STRING in both; otherwise control reaches the end of the STRING. No program can show a difference; the reader's phrase_order_overflow and str-2002.cob legs 5-6 run at 2002.

2002 list (alphanumeric, national, strongly-typed groups; not level 66) is 2023's less variable-length groups. Bit groups are excluded by both texts even though 2002 14.6.5 names them as D1/D2. Refusal and acceptance witnesses behave at 2002.

2002 14.6.5 equals 2023 14.7.6 without variable-length groups and message-tag (2023 additions) and with a NOTE sentence that changes no selection. The 2002-only reach is ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD, but this rule only requires CORR results equal separate SUBTRACT statements; the per-statement standard-arithmetic result belongs to GR1/GR3 (already DIFFERENT, PB5575). Probe at --std 2002 under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD: SUBTRACT CORR and the separate SUBTRACTs give identical results.
